about: The 'What now?' hint ladder (H1 nudge, H2 direction, H3 worked example) the Journal's Now tab offers for each Chapter 1 scene. Puzzle steps quote game-design/08_PUZZLE_DESIGNS.md word for word; non-puzzle decisions use the NEW hint text in game-design/22_PUZZLE_CLUE_DESIGN.md section 3. Scenes without authored hints fall back to the scene's own mission-card steps from the campaign catalog (player_actions), so no hint text is invented.
consumer_rules: Show at most one more level each time the player asks; never pre-fill a control (doc 22 section 2.3).
Using a hint never changes an ending, a star or a reward.
A scene with 'from': 'p02_mission_table' reads the three P-02 hints from p02_mission_table.json so the Journal and the Mission Table never drift.
A scene absent from 'scenes' uses the fallback: its catalog player_actions in order, with the exit condition as the last level when fewer than three actions exist.
